title: P4 Anthropic Messages Adapter
goal: Implement Anthropic Messages as a strict independent adapter over the P1 streaming contract.

facts.text: AgentProviderId, endpoints and headers currently contain no native Anthropic service.
The current manifest has OpenAI and OpenRouter hosts but no Anthropic host.
Pi implements Anthropic content blocks, tool deltas and adjacent tool-result conversion separately from OpenAI protocols.
Pi also contains Node SDK, OAuth, thinking/cache and raw-SSE error behavior that is outside or incompatible with BGSM's browser and privacy boundaries.

out: Claude OAuth or Claude Code identity

constraints: Use the shared provider event and aggregation contract.
Consecutive tool results must form valid Anthropic user content without losing tool_use_id.
Require message_stop and closed content blocks for success.
Thinking/reasoning blocks are ignored and never forwarded to UI or logs.
Before implementation, review every P4 Pi source listed in docs/plans/agent-provider/pi-source-reference.md at the pinned commit and update its comparison record.

Verify exact request, content-block, usage, stop and error shapes against current official Anthropic Messages documentation before implementation; official schemas and stricter BGSM privacy rules override Pi behavior.
P5 owns native provider registration and host permission changes.

requirements.text: Convert BGSM messages and tools into valid Anthropic Messages content blocks and headers.
Convert Anthropic text and tool_use streaming events into normalized provider events.
Normalize usage and stop reasons and reject malformed or unterminated streams.
Support prepared final aggregation for silent OrganizeJob-compatible consumers.
Complete the pinned Pi Anthropic comparison, confirm all wire fields against current official documentation and record every intentionally excluded Pi behavior.

acceptance_criteria.text: System messages, user/assistant content, tool_use and consecutive tool_result messages convert to valid Anthropic requests with correct headers and IDs.
Text and tool argument deltas assemble across arbitrary chunks and expose only complete validated tool calls.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Content-block and tool delta fixtures pass.

acceptance_criteria.text: Input/output usage and stop reasons normalize correctly; error events, malformed blocks, missing block closure and missing message_stop fail closed.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Usage, stop, error, abort and truncation fixtures pass.

acceptance_criteria.text: Prepared request execution remains exact, single-use and independent of UI streaming subscribers.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Prepared request and OrganizeProposalAnalyzer compatibility tests pass.

acceptance_criteria.text: The P4 comparison record names the reviewed Pi commit, confirms the official Messages schema check, records adopted/adapted/rejected choices and explicitly excludes SDK/OAuth/cache/thinking and raw-payload error behavior.
acceptance_criteria.proof: Review docs/plans/agent-provider/pi-source-reference.md and verify its P4 status is no longer Pending.

design.summary: Create an Anthropic-specific message converter and content-block state machine that emits P1 normalized events and requires explicit protocol completion.
boundaries: Adapter owns Anthropic headers and content-block conversion.
P1 owns SSE, budgets and final aggregation.
Agent loop owns tool schema validation and execution.
P5 owns service registration and host access.
contracts: Content blocks start, delta and stop in valid order.
Thinking content never becomes assistant text.
compatibility: Keep final ModelResponse and prepared request contracts.
Use API-key Messages only in v1.
Review Pi's Anthropic state machine and conversion, but do not import its SDK path or copy OAuth, cache, thinking/signature or raw-payload error behavior.
rollout: Add strict terminal and error handling.
rollback: Remove the adapter without changing P1 or OpenAI paths.
P5 must not register Anthropic until this bundle is verified.
observability: Record protocol, duration, content-block/event counts, bytes and stop category.
Do not log content, arguments, headers or credentials.

steps.text: Review the pinned P4 Pi sources, compare them with current official Anthropic Messages documentation and update the comparison record before coding.
Implement Anthropic headers and message/tool conversion.
Implement content-block streaming, tool argument assembly, usage and strict message_stop handling.
Add prepared final aggregation and compatibility tests.

verification.procedure: Run request/header conversion fixtures for system, text, tool_use and adjacent tool_result messages.
Run text, tool delta, usage, stop, error, abort, malformed block and missing-message_stop fixtures.
Run prepared request and OrganizeProposalAnalyzer compatibility tests with the Anthropic adapter.
Run pnpm typecheck and pnpm test:logic.
Verify the P4 comparison record cites the pinned Pi revision and current official Anthropic schema, records exclusions, and confirms no Pi/Anthropic Node SDK import or raw payload logging was added.

risks.risk: Tool results violate Anthropic message alternation or lose tool identity.
risks.trigger: Adjacent tool results are emitted as unrelated turns.
risks.mitigation: Merge compatible tool results into one user content-block turn and preserve tool_use_id.

risks.risk: Thinking content leaks into UI or logs.
risks.trigger: Unknown content blocks are treated as normal text.
risks.mitigation: Allowlist visible text/tool blocks and ignore thinking blocks.

risks.risk: A truncated block or stream is accepted.
risks.trigger: EOF substitutes for content_block_stop or message_stop.
risks.mitigation: Require all block and message terminal events.

risks.risk: Pi behavior leaks content or introduces Node-only scope.
risks.trigger: Implementation copies SDK/OAuth/cache/thinking paths or embeds raw SSE data in an error.
risks.mitigation: Use Pi as required comparison material only, derive wire behavior from official docs and enforce BGSM redaction and browser-runtime boundaries.
